title: Idea2Prior: Auditable Paper Retrieval and Ranking from Research Ideas
abstract: arXiv:2610.20857v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Finding a paper from an informal research idea requires more than matching topic words: relevant work may use different terminology, and its distinguishing mechanism may be absent from the abstract. We present \system{}, an auditable literature-search system built on PaperArena. It combines multi-source discovery, identity verification, facet-based abstract assessment, semantic citation expansion, and joint Expert ranking. A retrieval-only mode ranks up to five papers from a shortlist of at most 60, using complete available abstracts and locally selected PDF evidence from five fixed acquisition attempts, without generating a long-form report. In a historical comparison covering ten queries from each of EASY, MEDIUM, and HARD, aggregate reported Hit@5 is 53.3\% for \system{}, 43.3\% for ChatGPT web Deep Research, and 36.7\% for Gemini web Deep Research under the documented accounting convention. translated_title: Idea2Prior：从研究想法出发的可审计论文检索与排序
translated_abstract: 从一个非正式的研究想法出发寻找相关论文，仅靠匹配主题词是不够的：相关工作可能使用不同的术语，而其独特的机制可能并未体现在摘要中。我们提出了Idea2Prior，一个构建在PaperArena之上的可审计文献检索系统。它结合了多源发现、身份验证、基于分面的摘要评估、语义引用扩展以及与Expert的联合排序。其“仅检索”模式从最多60篇的候选名单中对至多五篇论文进行排序，利用完整可用的摘要以及通过五次固定获取尝试在本地筛选出的PDF证据，而无需生成长篇报告。在涵盖EASY、MEDIUM、HARD三个难度各十个查询的历史比较中，按照所记录的统计口径，Idea2Prior的总体报告Hit@5为53.3%，ChatGPT网页版Deep Research为43.3%，Gemini网页版Deep Research为36.7%。该优势主要集中在EASY和MEDIUM等级上。
tldr: 提出了构建于PaperArena之上的可审计文献检索系统Idea2Prior，能从非正式研究想法出发，通过多源发现、身份验证、分面摘要评估、语义引用扩展与Expert联合排序来检索和排序论文，其Hit@5达53.3%，超过ChatGPT和Gemini的Deep Research。
en_tdlr: Idea2Prior is an auditable literature-search system built on PaperArena that retrieves and ranks papers from informal research ideas through multi-source discovery, identity verification, facet-based abstract assessment, semantic citation expansion, and joint Expert ranking, achieving 53.3% Hit@5 and outperforming ChatGPT and Gemini web Deep Research.
